headline: Bitcoin holds around $64,500 to $65,000 in extreme fear as traders wait for US retail sales, Fed speakers and Nvidia's results later today US time, with a December Fed rate rise almost fully priced in.

market.asOf: Read at about 07:55 UTC Tue 17 Nov (about 14:55 Bangkok) from the CoinGecko coin pages; CoinGecko prices shown. CoinMarketCap had BTC $64,206.54 (down 1.60% in 24 hours), ETH $1,806.76 (up 0.38%) and SOL $71.25 (up 2.28%). Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear, read at about 07:55 UTC Tue 17 Nov: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 10 (29 a week ago), CoinMarketCap's index 13.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 after its worst week in months, with Nvidia's results due tonight
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading around $64,500 to $65,000 after a weekend drop to near $62,000, its lowest since July. Nvidia, the AI chip maker whose results often move tech stocks and crypto together, reports after the US close today, its first report since CEO Jensen Huang resigned.
points: Bitcoin has dropped more than 15% this month to about $64,600, per CoinDesk (17 Nov).
Over the past week bitcoin fell 14.2%, ether 18.2% and solana 19.7%, and about $2.02B of leveraged bets were wiped out in one 24-hour period, $1.68B of them bets on rising prices, per The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had 7 straight days of outflows through Friday, about $1.9B, per CoinDesk.
Nvidia's results come about 4:20pm ET (about 04:20 Wed Bangkok), with the call at 5pm ET. Analysts expect revenue of about $109.1B, per Bloomberg data cited by Saxo.
Huang resigned on 12 November and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, per Nvidia's filing with the SEC.

sources.label: Nvidia: SEC filing on CEO transition

stories.title: Markets bet on a December Fed rate rise; US retail sales and Fed speakers today
stories.summary: Futures markets now treat a Fed interest-rate rise on 9 December as close to certain; the open question is whether it is a quarter point or half a point. Higher rates make cash and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from assets like bitcoin. Today's US retail sales and several Fed speeches are the next clues.
points: CME FedWatch showed about a 90.7% chance of a 0.25-point rise and 9.3% for a 0.5-point rise, per CryptoTicker. CoinDesk puts the odds of a rise at about 92%. These are market bets, not a Fed decision.
The Fed's target range is 3.75% to 4%, and the 10-year US Treasury yield is back above 5%, per CoinDesk.
October retail sales come at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok): forecast +0.2% per Finviz, 0% per CoinDesk; September was +0.8%.
Fed Governor Waller speaks at 9:10am ET (21:10 Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve. Minutes of the October Fed meeting come Wednesday at 2pm ET (02:00 Thursday Bangkok).

sources.label: CryptoTicker: bitcoin price, Waller, rate hike

stories.title: Senate hearing today for two nominees to the CFTC, which has just one commissioner
stories.summary: The CFTC, the US regulator for futures and derivatives, including much of crypto trading and prediction markets, has only one sitting commissioner. The Senate Agriculture Committee holds a hearing today on two nominees to join it. Even if both are confirmed, two of its five seats would stay empty.
points: The hearing on nominees Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland is listed for 3:00pm ET (03:00 Wednesday Bangkok), per the Senate Agriculture Committee.
Chair Michael Selig is the only sitting commissioner of a five-seat commission, and no committee vote on the nominees is scheduled yet, per Bitcoin Magazine.
The Clarity Act, the crypto market-structure bill, failed a key Senate vote in September and lapses on 3 January unless revived, per Bitcoin Magazine.
The CFTC has also approved blockchain-based derivatives exchanges run by Backpack (announced Monday) and tZERO, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: CFTC approves Backpack and tZERO

briefs.title: MSCI to drop Strategy from its indexes
briefs.summary: MSCI will remove Strategy (MSTR), the biggest corporate bitcoin holder, from its global indexes after the close on 30 November; estimates of forced selling by index funds range from about $1.6B to $2.8B, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy keeps buying
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC for $33.4M at an average $68,887, taking it to 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, above the current price, per The Block.

briefs.title: Russia opens crypto buying to ordinary investors
briefs.summary: Russian retail investors can buy BTC, ETH and USDT from today, capped at 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary and only after passing a test, per edgeX News.

briefs.title: Judge acquits MEV bot brothers
briefs.summary: A US judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of wire fraud and related charges over a $25M Ethereum trading-bot exploit in April 2023, per The Block.

briefs.title: Supreme Court turns away Custodia Bank
briefs.summary: The Supreme Court declined to hear crypto bank Custodia's case, leaving in place a ruling that Fed banks can refuse it a master account, per Bitcoin Magazine.
